visualReview.scope: Static detailed exterior preview; maximum fidelity remains pending.
visualReview.notes: Inspected every listed standard frame after the final aperture correction: measured tall shaft and cone, ten flanges, two inscription-panel bands, east entrance, base steps, cornice and roof light. Reoriented roof reveals and entrance jamb plus dark chamber backing now close the visible sky gaps. The documented 52.844 m measured height and distinctive tapered profile remain intact. Inscription panels deliberately contain no fabricated lettering.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all four shared-material angles, four near/far details and north-up placement fixture. Shared brick and wood bindings resolve; courses remain metric and the entrance, roof aperture, flanges and cornice stay readable. Generic roof brick joints and facade coursing are a reusable material treatment rather than a surveyed historic bond. The flat fixture shows the east-facing entrance/light and centered tower, with no claim that the unmodeled mound is validated.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-QID OSM ring supplies the center; UNESCO nomination cardinal east entrance supplies the proposed heading. A circular map ring cannot establish a surveyed azimuth. The approximately 10 m mound is excluded from the GLB, and real terrain contact/mound coverage still needs site review.

fidelityReview.notes: Maximum fidelity remains pending: measured muqarnas and entrance details, Kufic inscriptions, full double-shell roof/chamber, site mound and archaeological context, masonry weathering and historic brick bonds are absent or simplified. Exterior render success does not certify these details.
